subject: Inbound webinar creative & microsegment invite flow — finalizing copy, lists, and reminder cadence
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Pete Marshall <pete@datascale.events>
Cc: Nora Jenkins <nora@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft invite + segments for Performance at Scale webinar — feedback needed

Team,

Attaching a first pass on invite copy and the audience microsegments for the "Performance at Scale" webinar (attached: invite_copy_v1.docx, audience_segments.csv). High-level asks:

- Marissa: please review subject line variants and suggested CTAs.
- Vivek: confirm which microsegments are ready to receive send (we need suppression lists cleaned).
- Pete/Nora (partners): any co-branding language we should bake into the invite?

Quick notes on the plan:
- Primary send: US-North America developer and platform-engineer lists (microsegments A/B/C in the attached CSV).
- Secondary send (warm): product managers and platform architects (smaller cadence).
- Reminder cadence we’re thinking: 1st reminder at T+3 days, final reminder T+1 day before the event; add a last-minute SMS for VIPs where we have numbers.

Copy variant highlights (in the doc):
- Variant A: concise, product-first, CTA = "Reserve your spot"
- Variant B: outcomes-focused, CTA = "See how we cut inference cost by 3x"

Tracking sheet (tracking_links_sheet.xlsx) includes UTM template and placeholder short links for A/B subject tests. I’ve added stub tracking params: utm_campaign=perf-scale-aug26; utm_source=email; utm_medium=invite.

Please reply with line edits / approval by EOD so we can lock creative and load lists into HubSpot on Monday.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invite_copy_v1.docx, audience_segments.csv, tracking_links_sheet.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft invite + segments for Performance at Scale webinar — feedback needed

Soojin — thanks for the draft. Quick pass below, inline items + a couple of attachments.

Inline thoughts:
- Subject tests: suggest these three (short):
  1) "How teams cut LLM inference cost by 3x — Aug 26"
  2) "Reduce latency, scale predictably — free webinar"
  3) "Performance at Scale: practical serving patterns"
  (I'll upload to subject_tests.csv)

- CTA: prefer outcome-driven CTA on the first email (Variant B) and product CTA on the reminder. So: Variant B in send 1, Variant A in reminder.

- Send windows: for NA devs let's do two waves: 9:30am PT and 12:30pm PT (to cover east coast inboxes). For EMEA/APAC we'll handle separately with local times.

- Reminders: agree with T+3 and T+1. Add a segmented "no-show nurture" that triggers a replay link + short 1-pager.

- Tracking: we need a canonical hubspot campaign ID; also add a Trello/Asana task to review link shortner redirects so we can update later.

I attached subject_tests.csv with the A/B group sizes I propose. I also pushed a tiny wording tweak for the opening line in invite_copy_v1.docx (keeps the same benefit, shorter).

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to run through the microsegment logic.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Demand Gen | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: subject_tests.csv

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Pete Marshall <pete@datascale.events>
Date: 2026-08-05T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft invite + segments for Performance at Scale webinar — feedback needed

Thanks for the draft — solid start. A few operational items from field ops: 

1) Microsegments: I trimmed the audience_segments.csv to remove ~6k stale contacts and flagged VIPs (column: VIP = TRUE). I’ll hand off the cleaned list to ops (we should be aware of our 180-day email engagement suppression rule).

2) Tracking links: use this short link pattern for A/B test routing:
   - http://rwd.in/ps-aug26?a=variantA&utm_campaign=perf-scale-aug26&utm_medium=email&utm_source=invite
   - http://rwd.in/ps-aug26?a=variantB&utm_campaign=perf-scale-aug26&utm_medium=email&utm_source=invite

   I added these to tracking_links_sheet.xlsx and included a mapping to HubSpot campaign ID (HS_CAMPAIGN_987654).

3) Reminders: +1 suggestion — for the T+1 reminder, use an alternate subject and a one-line testimonial pulled from the event deck (short social proof works well). Also recommend we suppress the T+1 for anyone who registered after the first reminder.

4) Co-branding: Pete, Nora — add your preferred partner logo (SVG) and a 1-line partner blurb we can include under the footer. If you can send that by EOD Friday we’ll include it in the final assets zip.

I’ll prepare the HubSpot import CSV once we lock the final segment IDs.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Pete Marshall <pete@datascale.events>
Date: 2026-08-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final assets + send ops checklist — Performance at Scale webinar (Aug 26)

Thanks everyone — finalizing based on your notes. Summary and owners below.

What’s attached: final_invite_assets.zip (includes final invite HTML, Variant A/B creative, subject_tests.csv, partner logos SVGs).

Send plan (US):
- Wave 1: 2026-08-10 09:30 PT — Variant B (outcome CTA) — segment: NA developers (microsegment A). Owner: Marissa.
- Wave 2: 2026-08-10 12:30 PT — Variant B — segment: NA platform engineers (microsegment B). Owner: Vivek.
- Reminder 1 (T+3): 2026-08-13 — Variant A (product CTA) — Owner: Marissa.
- Final reminder (T+1 day): 2026-08-25 — alternate subject + one-line testimonial — Owner: Vivek.

Operational notes:
- HubSpot campaign: HS_CAMPAIGN_987654 (Vivek added mapping).
- Short links configured: rwd.in/ps-aug26?a=variantA/B (tracked in tracking_links_sheet.xlsx).
- Suppression: apply 180-day engagement and all attended registrants.
- Partner assets: Pete/Nora to send final logo + 1-line blurb by EOD Friday.

Next steps:
- Marissa to upload subject_tests.csv into HubSpot and schedule first wave.
- Vivek to import cleaned audience CSV and confirm suppression.
- I will run final QA of email renderings (Litmus) and confirm link redirects.

If no objections, I’ll consider this approved and push assets to the shared drive (link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDeFG-invite-tracking) and trigger the Asana kickoff.

Thanks — good collaborative work.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: final_invite_assets.zip, tracking_links_sheet.xlsx
